description: Use when you need a wallet's token balances on several chains in one call: native coin plus USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /wallet/balance, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one token on one chain use evm_erc20_balance; for the native coin on one chain use evm_native_balance; for many wallets use wallet_balance_batch. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

address.description: 0x address or ENS name (lowercase a-z, 0-9, hyphen)

chains.description: comma list of ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon (default: all EVM chains for a 0x address)
